$comment: OUMV Standard Error Code Registry — canonical. spec/SPEC.md §5.1 and README.md render this set; packages/protocol/src/errors.ts is GENERATED from it by scripts/gen-errors.mjs; the conformance suite validates emitted codes against it. registryVersion bumps when the code set changes.

codes.name: INVALID_PARAMS
codes.meaning: Params missing or of the wrong type.

codes.name: CONFLICT_DETECTED
codes.meaning: expectedVersion does not match the current bytes.

codes.name: SECURITY_VIOLATION
codes.meaning: Path escapes the workspace or targets a sensitive file.

codes.name: TARGET_NOT_FOUND
codes.meaning: Endpoint/component/symbol target does not exist in the runtime.

codes.name: ACTION_NOT_FOUND
codes.meaning: Named action/effect is not defined on the target.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY
codes.meaning: Method/level/query not implemented (never a silent no-op).

codes.name: RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE
codes.meaning: Runtime or its sandbox is unreachable.

codes.name: STALE_RESOURCE_VERSION
codes.meaning: A version token carried by the caller no longer matches the versioned resource (static result or OCC token); refetch before retrying.

codes.name: VALIDATION_FAILED
codes.meaning: Payload violated a contract (incl. missing expectedVersion, expired session).

codes.name: RATE_LIMITED
codes.meaning: Per-session request limit exhausted (data.retryAfterMs hints when to retry; HTTP 429 may precede dispatch).
